references.title: Share board with invite and permissions
references.question: Q2
references.take: Share modal visibly combines email/name invite, per-person can edit/can view permission, invited-only vs team access, current avatars, and embed/publish actions; strong adjacent evidence for granular course access grants.

references.title: Course setup with curriculum preview
references.question: Q3
references.take: Course setup screen visibly presents Curriculum Preview, Preview curriculum, Edit curriculum, published status, and draft/published lesson indicators; useful preview availability evidence, though learner fidelity is not shown.

references.title: Class page with learner discussion
references.question: Q4
references.take: Class page visibly combines course title/summary, creator identity, Follow, engagement counts, comments, and navigation to My Classes; adjacent evidence for learner context and social updates, not direct progress or announcements.
